title: EpiFlowML run metadata row (fitOne.py)
description: One row of the CSV passed to fitOne(metadata, ROW, run_name). predictor must ast.literal_eval to dict[str, int] (lags in months). depVar optional (default cases_1M). environmentalArg optional (default {}). Seed optional (default 1337). binary_outbreak_threshold_per_m optional: sets binaryLabelMetric to x>=threshold for classification metrics (else wrapper default >=2). See model/METADATA_RUN_SCHEMA.md.

ROW_ID.description: Unique run identifier; used in output filenames.

country.description: ISO3 code or pooled selection key (e.g. cluster:1).

depVar.description: Optional. Dependent variable column name; default cases_1M if absent or blank.

environmentalArg.description: Optional. Python dict literal; omit column or leave blank for no extra predictors. "{}" explicitly.

Seed.description: Optional. Random seed for the estimator; default 1337 if column absent or null.

binary_outbreak_threshold_per_m.description: Optional. If set, fitOne passes binaryLabelMetric lambda x: x >= this value for evaluateCountry metrics. Else MeaslesModelEval defaultBinaryMetric (>=2).

binary_outbreak_threshold.description: Optional alias for binary_outbreak_threshold_per_m (used only if per_m column absent).

MODEL_ID.description: Optional design hash; not read by fitOne.py.
